The '''''Maledoth''''' was a former [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[slaveship]] that was turned over to the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The ship was eventually bonded with [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lowbacca]], whom the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] hoped would assist with a [[Ramoan relocation project]]. However, Lowbacca left for the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], bringing the project to a complete standstill because no one else possessed his understanding of the ship's Yuuzhan Vong biomechanics.

==History==
{{Quote|Lowbacca was the only one who completely understood the biomechanics of the ''Maledoth''.|The Jedi [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], to other senior Jedi Masters|<ref name="JK" />}}
[[File:LowbaccaSekot.jpg|right|thumb|270px|The Jedi Lowbacca was bonded with the ''Maledoth'' and understood the biomechanics of the vessel]]
The ''Maledoth'' was a huge<ref name="JK" /> [[slaveship]] belonged to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]],<ref name="JK" /><ref name="CEM" /> the [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] invaders,<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> during<ref name="CEM" /> their a massive [[Yuuzhan Vong War|conquest campaign]].<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref> The ''Maledoth'' was turned over to the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] in the wake of the invaders' [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|defeat]] at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="CEM" /> in [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Following the devastation caused by the Yuuzhan Vong War, the new galactic power, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], established the [[Reconstruction Authority]]<ref name="JK" /> to monitor the relocation and rebuilding of civilizations.<ref name="CERC">{{CSWECite|III|86|Reconstruction}}</ref> The former slaveship ''Maledoth'' was eventually bonded to the [[Lowbacca]] and the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Knight]] used it to transport [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] to new homeworlds for many years.<ref name="CEM" /> [[35 ABY/Legends|Six years]] after the war ended,<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the Reconstruction Authority launched a [[Ramoan relocation project|relocation project]] to evacuate the [[Ramoan]] population from their [[Ramoa|dying world]]. 	The Jedi Order had been hoping to use the ''Maledoth'' to accomplish this purpose, however, Lowbacca, the only one who completely understood the biomechanics of the vessel, along with other Jedi Knights abruptly abandoning their duties and departing for the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Without Lowbacca the project came to a complete standstill.<ref name="JK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ship ''Maledoth'' was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'', which was written by [[Troy Denning]]<ref name="JK" /> and released in [[2005]].<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> In [[2008]],<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/160596/the-complete-star-wars-encyclopedia-by-stephen-j-sansweet-pablo-hidalgo-bob-vitas-daniel-wallace/9780345477637|text=The Complete Star Wars® Encyclopedia}}</ref> an entry for the ''Maledoth'' was added to a reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CEM" />
